fact: Rowe, Gow-Smith and Hepple introduce a new machine translation dataset for Guinea-Bissau Creole (Kiriol) of around 40 thousand parallel sentences with English and Portuguese, and train transformer models on it.

The OKINKA site presents a national AI assistant in service in Portuguese, Kriol, French, Balanta, Fula and Mandinka, claiming state ownership and development with Estonia's Goldenseal Group; the site itself is the only source.
